name: Tomato Paste and Ham Sandwiches (Pan Tomaca)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Pa de pagès (Catalan bread) or 1 loaf French bread, sliced

steps: Peel the tomatoes, removing the seeds if desired.
Use an immersion blender to blend the tomatoes, 1 tbsp olive oil, and salt to taste in an appropriate vessel with an immersion blender.
If desired, toast the bread slices very lightly.
Spread the tomato mixture on one slice of bread, drizzle with olive oil, and top with a slice of cured ham. Repeat with remaining bread slices.
Either top each slice with a second slice of bread to make a sandwich, or leave as an open-faced slice.

culture.text: Pa amb tomàquet also called pa amb tomaca, is a sandwich style dish or tapa originating in Catalonia but now enjoyed all over Spain. It means "bread with tomato". It is lightly toasted bread, rubbed with fresh tomato and sprinkled with olive oil and salt, with optional rubbed garlic, and served with, for example, slices of cured ham or cheese. Pa amb tomàquet is typically served as a starter or as a sandwich.
